name: Azure AI Foundry
summary: Microsoft's unified platform for discovering, customizing, and deploying AI models (including Azure OpenAI Service models) with built-in evaluation, monitoring, and governance tooling.

name: Amazon Bedrock
summary: A fully managed service offering a single API to access foundation models from multiple providers, with built-in fine-tuning, agents, guardrails, and knowledge base (RAG) support.

name: Google Vertex AI
summary: Google Cloud's unified ML/AI platform covering model access (including Gemini), fine-tuning, RAG/grounding, agent building, and MLOps tooling.

name: Azure AI Search
summary: A managed search service with built-in vector, keyword, and hybrid search, commonly used as the retrieval layer in enterprise RAG architectures on Azure.

name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
summary: A managed search and analytics service with vector engine support, commonly used as the retrieval layer for RAG architectures on AWS.

name: Vertex AI Vector Search
summary: Google Cloud's managed, high-scale approximate nearest-neighbor vector search service, used for embedding-based retrieval.

source.title: Vertex AI Vector Search documentation
source.reference: Google Cloud — Vertex AI Vector Search.

name: Amazon HealthLake
summary: A HIPAA-eligible managed data lake purpose-built for healthcare data, storing clinical data in the FHIR standard format and enabling structured querying and analytics.
